# cicirello/user-statistician

One SVG with four sections: general, contributions, repositories and languages. Inputs of `cicirello/user-statistician@v1`.

## Dark themes

### dark

`colors: dark`

![dark](theme-dark.svg)

### dark-dimmed

`colors: dark-dimmed`

![dark-dimmed](theme-dark-dimmed.svg)

### dark-high-contrast

`colors: dark-high-contrast`

![dark-high-contrast](theme-dark-high-contrast.svg)

### dark-colorblind

`colors: dark-colorblind`

![dark-colorblind](theme-dark-colorblind.svg)

### dark-tritanopia

`colors: dark-tritanopia`

![dark-tritanopia](theme-dark-tritanopia.svg)

### halloween

`colors: halloween`

![halloween](theme-halloween.svg)

## One section each

### General

`hide-keys: contributions, repositories, languages`

![General](section-general.svg)

### Contributions

`hide-keys: general, repositories, languages`

![Contributions](section-contributions.svg)

### Repositories

`hide-keys: general, contributions, languages`

![Repositories](section-repositories.svg)

### Languages

`hide-keys: general, contributions, repositories`

![Languages](section-languages.svg)

## Other options

### Animated language chart, every language

`animated-language-chart: true, max-languages: 100`

![Animated language chart, every language](animated-languages.svg)

### No title, no border

`include-title: false, show-border: false`

![No title, no border](no-title-no-border.svg)

### Small custom title, featured repository

`custom-title: GitHub Stats, small-title: true, featured-repository: design-system`

![Small custom title, featured repository](featured-small-title.svg)

### Simplified Chinese

`locale: zh-Hans`

![Simplified Chinese](locale-zh-hans.svg)
